description: Update a translation post's units (PUT /units/post/{id}). units writes manual translations (key -> text, only keys of the source); approve marks keys reviewed; machine queues those keys for machine translation (a key the same request edits is skipped as `edited`); machine_now (needs machine, cvrt_lang_manage) translates them within the request instead of queueing; publish publishes the post. Send only what changes.

id.description: Translation post ID (not the source post)

machine_now.description: Translate `machine` keys now, in this request (needs machine)

name: lang_update_units
